topics.title_zh: 英伟达黄仁勋被罢免：SEC会计调查与高管丑闻引发市值崩塌
topics.title_en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Ousted: SEC Audit Probe and Governance Scandal Trigger Market Rout
topics.summary_zh: 英伟达创始人黄仁勋因公司治理与诚信问题被董事会罢免。受此重创叠加SEC对其会计实务的深度调查，英伟达股价连续七周下挫，市值回落至3.1万亿美元，不仅动摇了全球AI算力供应链的基石，更引发了资本市场对AI泡沫破裂的集体恐慌。
topics.summary_en: Nvidia founder Jensen Huang has been ousted by the board over governance and ethics scandals. Compounded by an ongoing SEC accounting investigation, the stock has plummeted for seven consecutive weeks, slashing market cap to $3.1T. This leadership vacuum threatens the foundation of the global AI supply chain and fuels fears of a broader AI market bubble.

perspective_pro.speaker_zh: 英伟达独立董事会与财务合规委员会
perspective_pro.point_zh: 罢免行动旨在根除长期存在的诚信隐患与财务黑箱，通过重塑透明度，确保公司在后黄仁勋时代维持长期合规与战略稳健。
perspective_pro.point_en: The removal aims to purge deep-seated integrity risks and financial opacity. By resetting leadership, the board seeks to ensure long-term regulatory compliance and strategic stability.

perspective_con.point_zh: 黄仁勋是英伟达算力帝国的唯一灵魂，激进罢免剥离了公司最核心的创新驱动力，将引发算力基建布局的瘫痪与人才大规模流失。
perspective_con.point_en: Jensen Huang is the singular soul of Nvidia’s empire. An abrupt ousting strips away the core innovation engine, risking total paralysis in computing infrastructure and massive brain drain.

topics.title_zh: GTA VI首日吸金37.9亿美元：AI辅助营销重塑娱乐经济天花板
topics.title_en: GTA VI Rakes $3.79B in Day-One Sales: AI Marketing Rewrites Entertainment Revenue Records
topics.summary_zh: Take-Two旗下《GTA VI》首日营收创下37.9亿美元的惊人纪录，超越《复联4》全球影史终身票房。各地警方利用AI生成的《GTA》风格征兵广告进行病毒式营销，尽管引发争议，却揭示了AI辅助内容在重塑现代消费与社会动员机制中的巨大影响力。
topics.summary_en: Take-Two's GTA VI shattered records with $3.79B in day-one sales, surpassing the lifetime gross of Avengers: Endgame. Meanwhile, police forces nationwide utilized AI-generated GTA-style ads for recruitment. This success underscores the terrifyingly efficient power of AI-driven content in capturing mass consumer attention and social narratives.

perspective_pro.speaker_zh: 营销科技从业者与Take-Two策略官
perspective_pro.point_zh: AI生成内容的实时性和感染力极大降低了触达边际成本，成功将游戏IP转化为超越媒介形态的全球文化现象级资产。
perspective_pro.point_en: The real-time adaptability and viral nature of AI-generated content lowered acquisition costs, transforming the game IP into a cultural phenomenon that transcends traditional media forms.

perspective_con.speaker_zh: 数字伦理观察家与社会批判者
perspective_con.point_zh: 公共权力机构利用商业游戏IP进行政治化营销，本质上是算法对大众注意力的深度剥削，模糊了游戏娱乐与国家机器的界限。
perspective_con.point_en: Public institutions leveraging commercial gaming IP for recruitment is an exploitative use of algorithms to siphon mass attention, dangerously blurring the lines between state power and leisure.

topics.title_zh: TML发布Inkling 2 Mini：5.4B激活参数实现大模型推理降维打击
topics.title_en: TML Launches Inkling 2 Mini: 5.4B Active Parameters Achieving Breakthrough Reasoning Efficiency
topics.summary_zh: Thinking Machines Lab推出的Inkling 2 Mini模型，通过特殊的循环中间层设计，在仅5.4B激活参数下展现出对标Qwen3.8 27B的推理能力。此项创新通过循环计算机制显著提升了推理密度，极大地优化了端侧模型在笔记本运行时的算力经济性。
topics.summary_en: Thinking Machines Lab’s Inkling 2 Mini uses a looping middle-layer architecture to achieve performance comparable to a 27B parameter model with only 5.4B active parameters. This innovation maximizes reasoning density per token, proving that structural efficiency can outperform sheer parameter scaling in laptop-class local AI deployments.

perspective_pro.speaker_zh: 推理架构研究员与边缘计算开发者
perspective_pro.point_zh: 循环Transformer架构证明了参数规模不再是性能的唯一护城河，通过精细化计算路径，可在低功耗设备上实现超预期的推理深度。
perspective_pro.point_en: The looping transformer architecture proves that parameter counts are not the only moat. By refining compute paths, we can achieve high-depth reasoning on low-power devices.

perspective_con.speaker_zh: 传统大模型工业派工程师
perspective_con.point_zh: 循环层设计虽能缩短处理路径，但存在严重的推理延迟累积风险，且在复杂长链路任务上难以保持与同参数量级模型的泛化稳定性。
perspective_con.point_en: Looping layers risk cumulative latency and struggle with generalization stability on complex, long-chain reasoning tasks compared to standard massive models.

linked_news.title_zh: 人工分析称 Inkling 2 Mini 具有 5.4B 的活动参数，其智能指数与 Qwen3.8 27B (xhigh) 相匹配，但活动参数少约 5 倍（人工分析）
linked_news.title_en: Artificial Analysis says Inkling 2 Mini, with 5.4B active parameters, matches Qwen3.8 27B (xhigh) on its Intelligence Index with ~5x fewer active parameters (Artificial Analysis)

linked_news.title_zh: TML 发布了 Inkling 2 Mini，这是一个开放权重 26.4B 参数转换器，每个 token 循环中间层 3 次，以便用更少的 token 进行更好的推理（Thinking Machines La）
linked_news.title_en: TML releases Inkling 2 Mini, an open-weights 26.4B-parameter transformer that loops middle layers three times per token for better reasoning with fewer tokens (Thinking Machines Lab)
